summary: Complete bounded grid dense forward and backward: construct combined memory admission and terminating reductions, compose padded pointwise stages, and prove stored TorchLean VJP correspondence with unchanged numerical conditions.

examined.reason: Complete finite combined grid admission and row-reduction execution existence; expose completed grid launch contracts, explicit physical padding/logical views and backward composition. Summaries, exact links and implemented status match the bounded scope.

The multi-group forward and all five backward stages now have universal stored-result/numerical contracts and separate admitted witnesses, including empty dimensions. Numerical policy and exclusions remain unchanged; full private scratch cost and padding margin are explicit.

Reconciles the parent reference to the child: bounded grid existence and stored composition are now proved. The instruction, candidate read and barrier semantics are unchanged, as are exclusions for general communicating groups and hardware/runtime behavior. Existing summary remains accurate.

The integration checker retains pinned versions, exact source hashes, forbidden-proof guard and standard-only axiom policy. New admission and existence are internal adequacy results, not new source-fidelity or hardware-conformance evidence.

This example continues to identify concrete tensors, actual stored handoffs, numerical conditions, reproducible checks and bounded scope; its expanded implementation does not redefine the PTX ISA coverage.

The scalar instruction/state contract is unchanged. New witnesses combine actual bounded fetched steps, maintain the distinction between memory admission and address safety, and prove completion separately from finite running procedures.

results.method: bash scripts/check.sh; bash integration/torchlean/check.sh; stratic validate; git diff --check; manual review of source/graph/witness composition and description links
results.environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0 and project-pinned numerical/TorchLean dependencies; existing local dependencies checked for exact clean revisions. No external model calls, GPU execution or benchmarking.
results.evidence: Root source/build suite and 1643 exact dependency reports passed. Integration built all 149 default targets, freshly executed 4 dense, 6 single-group backward, 7 grid pointwise/private, 6 grid forward and 7 grid backward interpreter cases, and checked 1525 exact dependency reports with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The grid backward includes a 33x32 matrix and all empty-dimension combinations, plus an arbitrary-word large-shape existence instantiation. Integration source/configuration hashes were unchanged across checks. Final parent-description clarification and guide wording received fresh root/Stratic validation; final snapshots before and after that verification match. New generic grid chronology and source construction preserve existing admission constraints; unchanged Encoding and Ranges supply numerical interpretation. No sorry or new unchecked axiom.

unmapped.reason: Updates integration check counts or documents the complete bounded grid contracts, explicit limitations and software checks; no stronger hardware claim is made.

Replaces explicitly partial status with the proved admission/existence and five-stage backward chain; explains physical padding, logical views, unchanged numeric policy, full private scratch cost and excluded hardware/runtime scope.
Retains complete original single-group study and links the now complete bounded grid milestone, with per-reduction limits and explicit storage costs.

Separates physical lane identity from logical dense index in concrete ordinary segments. Uses unchanged instruction lists, arithmetic bounds, address checks and floating-point reference; no desired data are premises.

Instantiates the existing serial certificate with derived sources and chronological coherence; proves ordered admission and absence of grounding cycles for concrete grid runs without assuming memory admission.
Assigns initial cells a finite rank ceiling and program events their full-trace position; proves injectivity and that existing initial/program/barrier base edges increase rank.

Retains current-array read evidence in real grid instruction steps, proves forgetting and concatenation, embeds actual group instructions, and connects reference schedules. It does not assert completion.

Seven fresh full five-stage interpreter cases check statuses, completion, chronological replay, gradients and operand preservation. Adds arbitrary-word theorem instantiation for 33x32 existence; examples are not substituted for generic proofs.

Five actual grid launches are linked by actual final arrays. Copies perform the transpose through instructions. Bounds apply to individual row reductions and explicitly reserve padding address margin; empty dimensions are included.
Derives stored gate, weight and input gradients, transposed packet values, lengths and original operand preservation from the actual grid launch contracts.

Combines each actual group run against the current shared global array, preserves idle private states, and constructs one admission certificate for the whole completed trace; empty groups are included.
Array wrapper retains actual completed admitted grid execution or explicit empty launch; exposes separate existence and universal result/frame contracts.
Derives logical control registers from actual fetched local prefixes using the existing address projection; registers and memory are not supplied as favorable intermediate facts.
Constructs product, reduction and output segments, actual barrier rounds and all exits for arbitrary stored words, assuming only explicit resource/storage/arithmetic bounds.

Explicitly appends physical padding outputs for 32-lane groups and takes the original-length logical view. Correctness proves all logical outputs and source words retained; no claim that padding stays unchanged.
Checks each tagged event against one global array and the selected private scratch, derives replay from concrete steps and the last preceding write or initial cell for every load.
Recovers read sources as actual initialization or preceding stores in the combined tagged trace. Same-location checks use group-private storage identities, and latest-write obligations are proved.
Constructs finite fetched ordinary-segment and exit sweeps. Proves untouched lanes and barrier-site framing; barriers are deliberately separate actual rounds.

Reuses existing Encoding, Ranges and pure numerical lemmas; connects actual grid stored words to TorchLean generated VJP and proves universal numerical correctness plus a separate composed witness. ReLU corner margin is unchanged.
Adds numerical nonvacuity using the new actual admitted grid launch existence; existing universal theorem and DenseForward.Encoding remain unchanged.
Adds 116 exact named dependency reports for all new public declarations and endpoint, keeping only the existing standard Lean axiom allowlist.
Updates integration check counts or documents the complete bounded grid contracts, explicit limitations and software checks; no stronger hardware claim is made.
Expands the expected audit to 1525 exact reports and the default build to 149 targets, and freshly runs all seven grid backward checks without changing pins, source guards or allowlist.
Registers the 16 new targets and the grid backward library while preserving pinned dependency/toolchain versions.
